rows.contract: PM ships DRY Method as default-on application-level assistant behavior through the single rules pipeline and Instruction Bundle. User can disable the default guard. Project-specific DRY conventions remain project-level rules.
negative_constraints: Do not make DRY Method opt-in by default.
Do not hard-code DRY Method so the user cannot turn it off.

settings_key_contract.scope: application-level PM assistant/agent behavior through the single rules pipeline; project-specific DRY conventions remain project-level rules
settings_key_contract.off_boundary: disabled_by_user disables only the default DRY guard and DRY-specific caveat/block behavior; it does not disable explicit user/project instructions, safety, secrets, source authority, governance boundaries, or source-control hygiene

negative_constraints: Do not hide trust-affecting missing/stale rule-source state in logs only.
Do not flood routine turns when DRY has no material effect.

receipt_and_copy_contract.visible_copy_policy: Show compact what/why copy only when DRY materially affected the turn, was disabled, degraded, missing/stale, blocked a canonical/implementation-changing mutation, or allowed exploratory chat with a caveat.
receipt_and_copy_contract.routine_policy: Routine turns with no material DRY effect may keep details in receipt/provenance only to avoid flooding the chat.

rows.contract: Every run/turn that assembles rules records an instruction-bundle provenance ref, including rules_application_sha256 and rules_project_sha256 or equivalent stable hashes, plus missing/stale/degraded flags when applicable.
negative_constraints: Do not let Contracts_V0 run.started minima under-enumerate rules provenance.

validation_rows: Assistant prompt route uses shared Instruction Bundle
Interview prompt route uses shared Instruction Bundle
Orchestrator prompt route uses shared Instruction Bundle
delegated child-run route inherits same assembly ordering
document-builder and code-generation routes do not carry prompt-builder-local DRY prose
default-on/off and fallback/block behavior are tested
negative_constraints: Do not allow parallel prompt-construction routes with different rule assembly order or names.

rows.contract: Exploratory chat proceeds with visible caveat when owner/source cannot be resolved; canonical or implementation-changing mutation blocks, asks clarification, or records bounded open item. DRY off removes DRY-specific block/caveat behavior only and does not bypass explicit instructions, safety, secrets, source authority, governance boundaries, or source-control hygiene.
negative_constraints: Do not interpret DRY Method off as permission to violate PM source authority or governance phase boundaries.

rows.contract: Retire Orchestrator-local DRY Method/widget-catalog prose as active owner text; keep subagent registry/platform reuse as consumer examples only where they point to current owners. Resolve orphaned Contracts_V0 header residue during explicit compile.
negative_constraints: Do not treat old widget/code paths as live DRY Method owners.
